notes.title: Announcement: Saku the Covert Agent Official Release
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/070f32fe2576bc46d911bbf44310ae8429309377.jpg[/img]

Following the previous update that added side quests, we've further optimized certain sound effects and puzzle loading performance. With this, the content for version 1.0 is now complete. As planned, the game will officially leave Early Access and be fully released today.

However, we will continue to update and expand the game's content moving forward.
 In the future, we plan to introduce two new heroines—Lucy and Eve—along with their exclusive story routes and puzzle stages.
These new main storylines will take place after Saku’s route and will be on par with the original Saku route in terms of scale and depth.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/9d49e05d12e18441002b3297b461ea582b417078.png[/img]

Please stay tuned for upcoming news and future updates!

notes.title: See you at Steam Visual Novel Festival! New Side Stories are updated!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce that "Saku the Covert Agent" is participating in the Steam Visual Novel Festival! Enjoy a limited-time 20% discount along with brand-new side missions. Check out the details below:

🔍 Internet Surfing
During your routine internet surveillance, you come across a recently popular mukbang streamer. He seems cheerful and enjoys his meals on screen, but subtle details hint at something unusual beneath the surface…
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/ca37f5ab69558bd6d49f25103bb333ee0c62a21b.png[/img]

📷 The Shut-in Teenager
A shy, photography-loving teenager has mysteriously locked himself in his room and refuses to go outside. His worried mother reaches out to you, hoping you can discreetly uncover what happened.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/134f9d1914e283e29fdc17f91460dfbaad3d68fe.png[/img]

🎤 The Idol Paparazzi Incident II
Previously, you helped singer Nova uncover the shocking truth—that her own mother and manager was behind the secret surveillance. With your help, she finally escaped the nightmare. But now, you receive a plea for help from the same manager—could there be more to this story than you thought?
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45015356/4332664e0f38822bae98abb216113b141832d3a1.png[/img]

The game is still in Early Access, and the development team will continue adding new side and main story content. Expect new characters as well as familiar faces returning! Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: More Clients Await!!
notes.content:
We have updated with more side stories and hope players can enjoy and have fun! More side stories and main stories will be continuously updated in the future! Please look forward to it! In addition to the main story co-written by the player and Saku, there are currently 6 side stories available for players to experience in the game.

[list]
[*] Exposing Corrupt Politicians
[*] Unveiling the Love, Hate, and Truth Behind Memories
[*] Exploring the Reality of the "Haunted House"
[*] Remote Protection of Children in a Fire Scene
[*] Searching for the Missing Street Artist
[*] Scandal of a Famous Idol's Hidden Camera
[/list]

Solving events not only enhances Shadow Code's reputation but may also gain special "rewards", or may even meet new friends, which unlocks entirely new story arcs.
